format: Append new decisions; never rewrite history. Supersede by adding a new entry and setting status=superseded + superseded_by on the old one.

decisions.title: Codependent Coding is an internal software factory, not a product
decisions.context: The first implementation built public catalog surfaces, a configuration workbench, and a multi-state application definition for an audience that does not exist.
decisions.decision: Scope is one user, local tooling: doctrine, Maximal Template, Hipster Stack CLI (unpublished), Loaded Vibes plugin, and a single landing page.
consequences: Anthimeria, Virgule, Arrangement, Simples, Ontologies retired as product terms

decisions.title: Keep only the homepage
decisions.decision: Delete every route except `/` and framework boundaries.
consequences: Monaco, catalog lib code, and @hipster-stack/core leave the root app

decisions.title: Subtractive composition from one runnable Maximal Template with computed ownership
decisions.context: The old generator's hand-maintained ownership catalog drifted: 226 of 300 paths no longer existed and a 'bare' app shipped 63 pages. An additive base+modules layout would force development in composed sandboxes and copy-back.
decisions.decision: Develop in one real app (`template/`). A file's owning module is computed from its path (explicit owns glob → path segment → basename prefix → base). The CLI deletes files owned by unselected modules.
alternatives: Additive base + module folders (TanStack-style) — rejected: worse solo DX, same metadata need
Keep hand catalog — rejected: proven to drift
consequences: Naming conventions are load-bearing and lint-enforced

decisions.title: Loaded Vibes becomes a Claude Code plugin
decisions.decision: Port from the Codex draft to a Claude Code plugin installed from a local marketplace in this repo; skills idea, plan, slice, classify, check, ship, handoff; agents reviewer, verifier; hooks for lint and execution-state.

decisions.title: One governance system under context/ and .claude/
decisions.decision: Intent in context/docs (5 md), contracts in .claude/contracts (3 yaml), execution in .claude/execution (3 json), work in context/specs/issues. `.agents/` is removed; AGENTS.md points to CLAUDE.md; TypeScripture books move to context/doctrine as reference only.

decisions.title: Pin TypeScript 6.0.3 and ESLint 9.39.5 everywhere
decisions.context: Root used TypeScript 7.0.2, which typescript-eslint 8.x rejects, so lint could not run. The template's TS 6.0.3 + ESLint 9.39.5 + eslint-config-next 16.3.4 lints successfully (verified 2026-10-22).
decisions.decision: Exact pins per tech-requirements.md §2; majors are explicit issues.

decisions.title: Presentation exceptions: forms, skeletons, client companions
decisions.context: The old validator reported 154 violations; 97 were skeletons importing ui/skeleton and client companions importing input controls, 53 were false positives.
decisions.decision: Form features may use UI primitives and 'use client'; skeletons may import ui/skeleton; .client.tsx companions may import interactive UI controls. Normal server features still render blocks only.

decisions.title: Doctrine enforced by a local ESLint plugin with CC-* rule IDs
decisions.decision: template/eslint/doctrine-map.mjs (tables) + codependent-plugin.mjs (mechanics) replace the separate architecture.mjs validator. One data-driven layer-boundaries rule avoids flat-config no-restricted-imports override collisions. Rule tests via ESLint RuleTester.
decisions.evidence: 44/44 rule tests pass; on the current template: 241 findings, auto-fix → 73, typecheck errors unchanged (123, all pre-existing).

decisions.title: Prisma multi-file schema with // @module tags; RLS SQL per owner
decisions.decision: Base models list module relations tagged `// @module <id>`; the CLI deletes tagged lines for removed modules. Policies live in prisma/rls/<owner>.sql and are applied by db:init.

decisions.title: GitHub Flow with issue branches and draft PRs
decisions.context: Previous instruction was 'work directly on main', producing many 'no comment' commits with no review points. Agent-driven work needs rollback points and Project automation.
decisions.decision: main + short-lived `<type>/<issue>-<slug>` branches, draft PR early with `Closes #N`, squash merge, Conventional Commits. No long-lived develop branch.

decisions.title: Active organization in an httpOnly cookie, re-validated every request
decisions.decision: Tenancy authority stays in Postgres; the cookie only names the org. Clerk Organizations are not used for tenancy.

decisions.title: Caching: ISR for public routes, fresh tenant routes, Cache Components off in v1
decisions.decision: Keep one simple mental model for v1; revisit Cache Components after v1.0.0.

decisions.title: Branded names kept for three components only
decisions.decision: Codependent Coding (doctrine/umbrella), Hipster Stack (CLI), Loaded Vibes (plugin), Maximal Template (template). Code and docs otherwise use plain engineering terms.

decisions.title: Deterministic work belongs to the CLI, not to agent tokens
decisions.context: Claude Pro usage limits are the binding constraint.
decisions.decision: Scaffolding (new, slice, add) is deterministic CLI output; plugin skills call the CLI and only write domain logic.

decisions.title: CC-001 pin details not fixed by tech-requirements §2
decisions.context: CC-001 asked for `yaml` (exact) without a version and for a root test script that works before M4 tests exist.
decisions.decision: Pin yaml 2.9.1 (latest stable on 2026-10-22). Root `test` is `vitest run --passWithNoTests` until M4 adds real tests. typescript-eslint dropped as a direct dependency: no config imports it (eslint-config-next brings it transitively).

decisions.title: Project board is user Project #19
decisions.context: context/specs/README.md named Project #3, which is an unrelated closed board. Two candidates existed: #19 'Codependent Coding™ — Canonical Remediation' (open, all 8 built-in workflows on) and #21 'Loaded Vibes Generator' (holds 34 older LV-/HS- issues, none of CC-001..044). Owner said either is fine.
decisions.decision: Use Project #19. issues:sync docs and script usage point at --project 19. #21 is left untouched.

decisions.title: CC-002 interpretation of legacy-governance scope
decisions.context: The Codex plugin that the spec places in .agents/ had already moved to .claude/LoadedVibesCodexPlugin/, which application.yaml does not list as an allowed .claude/ directory. content/README.md is not named in the scope. lib/docs.tsx read the books from content/. The rg acceptance check also matches Anthimeria product code that later issues delete.
decisions.decision: Delete .claude/LoadedVibesCodexPlugin/ as the Codex plugin named in scope. Move content/README.md with the books (it describes them). Point lib/docs.tsx at context/doctrine/ so the existing TypeScripture routes keep working until CC-006 removes them. Leave remaining Anthimeria/.agents mentions in app/, components/, packages/, template/AGENTS.md, README, SECURITY, CHANGELOG and package.json to CC-006/007/008/014/043 rather than widen CC-002. content.zip, tsconfig.tsbuildinfo, .agents/, the retired context/specs subfolders and context/mockups were already absent on main.

decisions.title: CC-004 CI step policy details
decisions.context: CC-004 allows continue-on-error only on template format/lint/typecheck, but the template has no test script until CC-017 and the root job stopped at its first failing step.
decisions.decision: Template test step is `pnpm run --if-present test` (skipped until CC-017, never masked). Root lint/typecheck/test use `if: !cancelled()` so every root check reports even after format:check fails. pnpm comes from pnpm/action-setup@v4 reading packageManager; setup-node caches by each lockfile.

decisions.title: CC-005 Windows lint-hook evidence and hook settings unchanged
decisions.context: In the VS Code extension on Windows, the lint hook gave no feedback after a write. The same run had a failed `pnpm install` (ERR_PNPM_PACKAGE_MANAGER_REMOVE_MODULES_DIR, Access is denied), so eslint was missing and the hook took its deliberate 'deps not installed' exit 0.
decisions.decision: Accept the owner's Windows run of the hook after a clean install (exit 2 with the ESLint finding) as the lint-feedback evidence. Keep .claude/settings.json unchanged, because the Node path and quoting work on Windows. Install with VS Code closed so node_modules is not locked.

decisions.title: Merge Dependabot bumps while root CI is red
decisions.context: Owner authorized merging Dependabot PRs and deleting stale branches. Root CI fails at format:check on main, so it cannot judge a bump; later root steps never run.
decisions.decision: Accept a bump when it keeps exact pins (no ranges, pnpm 12.3.4, node 24.x), the Maximal Template job is green, and a local root run (install, typecheck, test, cli:build) adds no new errors versus main. Merged #159, #205, #209; setup-node v7 (#160) applied directly after a merge conflict.

decisions.title: CC-006 interpretation: orphan components, dead links, and root lint
decisions.context: After removing the catalog routes, 117 components under components/{ui,chart,templates,blocks} plus library-icon and copy-definition-button were imported by nothing. They were the Simples catalog content and held all 250 root TS errors. The header, footer and hero linked to deleted routes, which typedRoutes rejects. Root lint still fails on packages/core and packages/loaded-vibes, which CC-007 deletes. playwright.config.ts had one exactOptionalPropertyTypes error.
decisions.decision: Delete every component that the kept app files do not reach (they existed only for the catalog). Remove links to deleted routes and leave the new CTAs and GitHub link to CC-008. Fix playwright.config.ts workers with a conditional spread and postcss.config.mjs default export so root typecheck and site lint are clean. Leave the 38 lint findings in packages/** to CC-007 instead of editing code that issue deletes. Keep lib/utils.ts, clsx and tailwind-merge. Leave dead selectors in app/globals.css and formatting to CC-008/CC-013.

decisions.title: CC-007 interpretation: salvage format, root validate script, kept deps
decisions.context: CC-007 salvages presets.ts, ontologies.ts and Loaded Vibes validators/prompts, but presets/ontologies import @hipster-stack/schema and the criterion says no @hipster-stack/* imports remain. Root package.json had no validate script although tech-requirements.md defines one and the issue validates with pnpm validate. tsdown, tsx, execa and @types/validate-npm-package-name were only used by the deleted CLI.
decisions.decision: Store salvaged code as *.ts.txt / *.mjs.txt under context/doctrine/salvage/ with a README, so nothing builds, lints or imports it and no eslint/tsconfig ignore is needed. Add root validate exactly as tech-requirements.md defines it (format:check, lint, typecheck, test). Keep tsdown, tsx, execa and @types/validate-npm-package-name in devDependencies for the M4 CLI rebuild and keep pnpm-workspace packages/* for packages/cli. Remove packages/loaded-vibes entries from tsconfig and vitest excludes. Leave format:check red to CC-013.

decisions.title: CC-008 interpretation: doctrine anchor target and metadata copy
decisions.context: CC-008 asks for a 'Read the doctrine' on-page anchor and a compact section listing the four components, but names no anchor target. The root layout's metadata description still used retired vocabulary (TypeScripture, Ontologies, Simples, Anthimeria) and no other issue owns it.
decisions.decision: The four-component section is the anchor target (id=doctrine), with one line per component taken from PRD §6. The GitHub link is a plain <a> to the public repo in the header and the CTA row. Footer keeps only the Digital Herencia wordmark. Rewrite the metadata description to name the four components. Dead CSS for deleted routes stays for CC-013.

decisions.title: CC-009: config and scripts already present; auto-fix only
decisions.context: CC-009 Scope asks to wire doctrine into template/eslint.config.mjs and add doctrine:test and lint:fix scripts. Both were already on main (governance package / CC-001). lint:fix does not run Prettier, so template format:check stays red.
decisions.decision: Confirm rather than re-add the config and scripts. Commit only the lint:fix output as its own commit. Leave the 73 remaining findings (layer-boundaries, non-null assertions, react-refresh, img, filename, use-client) to CC-010..012 and formatting to CC-013.

decisions.title: CC-010: rename server edit wrappers to *Feature; onboarding gate as a feature; roles in lib/constants
decisions.context: The *EditForm.tsx (and campaignNewForm.tsx) files were server components that fetch a record and render the real form, so they were classified as feature-form and tripped CC-FEAT-002. signIn/signUpFeature own RHF state. app/(tenant)/layout.tsx called an onboarding fetcher. The client companion imported appRoles from server-only lib/authz/roles.
decisions.decision: Rename the fetching wrappers to *EditFeature.tsx / campaignNewFeature.tsx (feature layer) and keep the forms receiving records as props; rename sign-in/up to signInForm/signUpForm (block import aliased to SignUpFormPanel); add features/onboarding/onboardingGateFeature.tsx that checks onboarding and renders TenantShell, the route keeps only the identity redirect; move appRoles to lib/constants/roles.ts (the path CC-011 names), lib/authz/roles re-exports it, and both admin client files import from constants. schemas/adminSchemas.ts and types/access.ts stay for CC-011. features/explorer (2 CC-FEAT-001) stays for CC-011, whose Scope says move or delete it.

decisions.title: CC-011: webhook persistence in *.tx.ts; provider-config reads in workflows; exact BigInt pipeline value
decisions.context: Route handlers and workflows may not import lib/db/provider (prisma-runtime), and transactions may not import integrations, so Stripe/SendGrid webhook claim/apply/fail logic had no legal home except lib/db/transactions. getAiPlaygroundConfiguration and getIntegrationStatuses read provider configuration, not persisted rows. lib/env does not exist. calculate-pipeline-value.logic.ts was unused and imported Prisma.Decimal from @prisma/client, which Prisma 7 no longer exports (a type error on main).
decisions.decision: Add stripe-webhook.tx.ts and sendgrid-webhook.tx.ts holding the logic unchanged (type-only imports for the input shapes); routes verify through the integration, map the Stripe subscription through the integration, then call the transaction. WebhookIdentityConflictError is imported from webhook-event.tx. Move getAiPlaygroundConfiguration to aiWorkflows.ts and getIntegrationStatuses to organizationWorkflows.ts (its only workflow caller) and delete the emptied integrationFetchers.ts. Rewrite calculatePipelineValue with BigInt at 6 decimal places (Decimal(19,4) value x whole percent), typed by CrmDealSummaryDTO; it is exact, where Prisma.Decimal rounds at 20 significant digits. Delete features/explorer (unused generator debris, Scope allows delete).

decisions.title: CC-012: fix at the cause, keep prettier out of the diff, next/image with fixed intrinsic sizes
decisions.context: 12 type errors (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, exactOptionalPropertyTypes, a stale generated-prisma path) and 34 lint problems remained. Ten files carried eslint-disable comments for react-refresh, a rule the config does not load. Ten raw tags lived in unused library blocks whose src is a prop.
decisions.decision: No tsconfig change. Guard indexed reads, use conditional spread for optional href, import CrmDealStage from generated/prisma/enums. Replace each non-null assertion with a guard or fallback; invoice line totals throw if missing (cannot happen, keeps the type honest). Remove the stale react-refresh disables. Convert to next/image with explicit width/height and the existing w-full/h-auto classes; remote image URLs passed to these blocks will need images.remotePatterns in the generated app. Remove unused SERVER_LAYERS_MSG from doctrine-map (no rule change). Keep Prettier off the touched files so CC-013 stays a formatting-only commit.

decisions.title: CC-013: root Prettier ignores template/; merge-commit to keep the baseline SHA
decisions.context: Root format:check re-exports the template Prettier config, whose tailwind plugin resolves template/app/globals.css imports (tw-animate-css) that are only installed in template/node_modules. The root CI job does not install template deps, so root format:check errored on every template file. Squash-merging would rewrite the formatting commit, so its SHA in .git-blame-ignore-revs would not exist on main.
decisions.decision: Add template/ to root .prettierignore; the template job's own format:check covers it (now blocking, continue-on-error removed). Keep the formatting commit alone, then a second commit with .prettierignore, .git-blame-ignore-revs, CI and records. Merge this PR with a merge commit (not squash) so 2bb0c68 lands on main unchanged.

decisions.title: CC-014: legal pages and LICENSE use a placeholder operator
decisions.context: CC-014 Scope removes Digital Herencia branding from template code and its rg check must return nothing, but content/privacy.tsx, content/terms.tsx and template/LICENSE named Digital Herencia and the owner's email as the operator. template/content is imported by the app, so it is not generator-only and stays.
decisions.decision: Add applicationOperator {name: 'Your Company', email: 'legal@example.com'} to content/application.ts; privacy and terms render it (uppercase where the clause is uppercase). Template LICENSE copyright holder becomes 'Your Company'. Wording is otherwise unchanged. The factory root keeps its own branding and LICENSE.

decisions.title: CC-015: route-group boundaries, daily ISR, form skeletons for edit pages
decisions.context: CC-015 needs error/loading per route group, ISR on public pages and Suspense + feature skeleton on every dynamic tenant page (CC-UX-001). Eleven edit pages read a record before rendering a form and had no Suspense. All edit forms share one card layout.
decisions.decision: Each route group gets error.tsx (GenericErrorPage block with reset) and loading.tsx (PageLoadingState block). Public pages and / export revalidate = 86400 (matches cacheLife.static; segment config must be a literal). New FormLoadingState block mirrors the shared form card; per-entity feature skeletons (crmFormSkeleton, expenseFormSkeleton, ...) render it with field count and width. Admin user edit reuses AdminUserDetailSkeleton because it renders the detail feature. */new pages stay unwrapped: no data read.

decisions.title: CC-017: Vitest replaces node:test in the template; E2E smoke over HTTP
decisions.context: Template tests used node:test and imported server-only modules. With Clerk development keys, browser navigations are redirected to Clerk's handshake host before the app renders, so a browser smoke depends on network access to Clerk. CC-016 needs a Vitest runner, so CC-017 lands first (both depend only on CC-012).
decisions.decision: Tests import test from vitest; vitest.config.ts aliases @/ to the template root and server-only to its empty export. test:rls and e2e paths are excluded from `pnpm test`. Playwright smoke uses the request fixture: GET / is 200 with an h1, GET /dashboard without a session is a 3xx to /sign-in. No browser install is required. Pins follow tech-requirements (vitest 4.1.11, @playwright/test 1.62.1); Dependabot may bump them later.

decisions.title: CC-016: catalog-driven RLS harness; CI uses a short-lived Neon branch
decisions.context: CC-016 needs real-Postgres proof of tenant isolation as the runtime role. prisma/rls/ and db:init do not exist until CC-022/CC-023; RLS lives in migrations. The owner asked (issue #176 comment) for an rls CI job on a short-lived Neon branch via a SHA-pinned create-branch-action, app_user without BYPASSRLS, tests connected as app_user, branch deleted if: always(), no connection strings printed. WebhookEvent and IdempotencyRecord have a nullable organizationId and no RLS.
decisions.decision: The suite (tests/rls) migrates as owner with prisma migrate deploy and applies prisma/rls/*.sql when present, so CC-023 can switch to db:init without changing the job. Tenant tables = tables with NOT NULL organizationId, discovered from the catalog; rows are generated from column types and FKs so new tables are covered automatically. Assertions run as app_user: DATABASE_URL_TEST_APP login when set (CI), else SET ROLE to a NOLOGIN app_user (local). Negative checks: catalog test fails when a tenant table lacks enabled+forced RLS or a policy; a rollback-only probe disables RLS on CrmContact and expects leaks. WebhookEvent and IdempotencyRecord are system tables (written before a tenant is known) and pinned in SYSTEM_TABLES; any new nullable-org table fails the suite until reviewed. CI fetches the owner URL from the Neon API inside one step and masks it before use; the branch is deleted through the Neon API.

decisions.title: CC-018: module manifest facts and validation
decisions.context: CC-018 asks for template/hipster.modules.json with a Zod schema (template/scripts until packages/cli exists) and a generated JSON Schema. Architecture §5.1 shows crm dependsOn email as an example, while application.yaml's crm preset is [crm] alone.
decisions.decision: Domain dependsOn equals the add-ons its application.yaml preset pulls in (crm has none), so presets and dependencies agree. Add-on owns/packages/env come from the existing lib/integrations/*, app/api/* and .env.example; ratelimit has none yet (CC-026). Explicit owns only where a route folder name differs from the module id (my-tasks -> projects, invoices/expenses -> invoicing); everything else is left to the computed conventions in CC-019. Objects are strict so unknown fields fail. hipster.modules.schema.json is generated with z.toJSONSchema; check-modules.mjs compares it structurally and fails when stale (--write regenerates). A .d.mts gives the TypeScript test types because allowJs is off. CI's template job runs pnpm check:modules.

decisions.title: CC-019: ownership resolver semantics and report
decisions.context: Architecture §5.2 orders the ownership rules (owns glob, path segment, basename prefix, base) and calls two modules matching the same file an error, without saying whether a later rule can conflict with an earlier one.
decisions.decision: Rules are tried in order and the first rule that matches any module decides; two or more modules matching at that rule is the ambiguity (owner null). So features/social/mediaLibraryFeature.tsx is social (segment beats basename) while app/(tenant)/social/media/page.tsx is ambiguous (two segments). The segment rule looks at directory segments only; file names go through the basename rule. Files come from git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard so ignored output never counts. Globs use node:path matchesGlob (no new dependency). The snapshot test records module counts and ambiguities but not the base count, which changes with every tooling or test file. check:ownership is not in CI yet: it exits 1 on the 2 current ambiguities, which CC-020 fixes and then wires into CI/validate.

decisions.title: CC-020: renames for unambiguous ownership
decisions.context: After CC-019, check:ownership reported 2 ambiguous route pages (portal/billing, social/media), and domain transactions, project templates and upload code sat in base because their names lacked a module prefix.
decisions.decision: Domain transactions are renamed <module>-<verb>-<noun>.tx.ts, dropping a repeated module word (add-portal-version -> portal-add-version, assign-crm-record -> crm-assign-record); the provider webhook transactions become billing-record-stripe-webhook and email-record-sendgrid-webhook; webhook-event, idempotency, clerk-user, onboarding and errors stay base. Project templates take the projects prefix; sharedBillingSettingsTemplate becomes billingSettingsTemplate. assetWorkflows (Vercel Blob) becomes uploadsWorkflows, and uploadWorkspaceAsset moves from commonActions to uploadsActions; commonActions and organizationWorkflows keep only base code (integration status is cross-module and moves to the registry in CC-021). The two ambiguous pages are resolved by explicit owns globs for app/(tenant)/portal/** and app/(tenant)/social/** instead of renaming routes, so URLs do not change. social now dependsOn uploads because socialActions uses the uploads workflow (amends DEC-033: dependsOn follows real imports; presets unchanged). The transaction filename pattern is unchanged; only its example now shows the module prefix. check:modules and check:ownership run in template validate and CI.

decisions.title: CC-021: module registry drives nav, dashboard and the permission catalog (current role model kept)
decisions.context: CC-021 makes base read modules only through lib/modules/registry.ts, including the authz permission catalog. The code uses 8 MembershipRole values and '<module>:<action>' strings; AUTH.md §5.2 and application.yaml describe 4 roles and '<module>.<resource>:<action>'. No backlog issue owns that migration, which needs a Prisma enum migration and edits to every action and fetcher. Asked the owner on a decision card with this option recommended; work proceeds on it meanwhile.
decisions.decision: types/moduleTypes.ts defines ModuleDefinition {id, nav, settings, dashboard, permissions{resources, catalog, grants}}. One lib/modules/<id>.module.ts per manifest module (add-ons are mostly id only; billing contributes the Settings > Billing link). registry.ts carries the generated header and lists modules in manifest order, typed readonly ModuleDefinition[] so an empty array still type-checks and builds. lib/authz/permissions.ts assembles the catalog as base (organization:read/write) plus each module's catalog; OWNER/ADMIN hold everything, other roles get base grants plus module grants. A test pins the assembled grants to the pre-registry table, so behavior is unchanged. Permission is now base literals | `${string}:${string}`; to keep typo safety a test checks that every permission literal passed to assertPermission/hasPermission/authorizeOwnedOrAssignedWrite exists in the catalog. ResourceKind is a string; lib/authz/resources.ts exposes resourceKinds from the registry. The tenant shell builds sidebar groups from lib/modules/navigation.ts and maps icon names to lucide icons; the dashboard renders each module's dashboard entries; applicationCapabilities and the module entries in lib/constants/routes.ts are removed. The AUTH.md role/permission format gap stays open for a separate issue if the owner confirms.

decisions.title: CC-022: multi-file Prisma schema with @module tags
decisions.context: CC-022 splits prisma/schema.prisma into prisma/schema/<owner>.prisma and tags cross-module relation fields so the CLI can drop a module's file and its tagged lines.
decisions.decision: base.prisma holds generator and datasource (generator output now ../../generated/prisma). identity.prisma holds User, Organization, Membership, OrganizationSettings, AuditEvent, WebhookEvent, IdempotencyRecord and their enums. Each module file holds its models and the enums only it uses: billing (BillingSubscription), uploads (Asset), crm, projects, support, marketing, invoicing, social, ai, portal; admin has no models. Every relation field pointing at another module's model is tagged `// @module <target>`, on base and module models alike (57 tags), since module-to-module relations (Expense/SocialPostMedia/PortalDocumentVersion -> Asset) must go too. The split was generated by script and checked equal to the old schema block by block (comments and whitespace ignored). scripts/check-schema-modules.mjs removes each module plus its transitive dependents (manifest dependsOn), strips tagged lines and runs prisma validate, then does the same with every module removed; it runs in the CI template job (about 15 s), not in validate. Migrations are unchanged (CC-023 owns db:init).

decisions.title: CC-023: RLS SQL per owner, idempotent, shared by db:init and test:rls
decisions.context: CC-023 moves RLS into prisma/rls/<owner>.sql and adds db:init. The template already ships migrations that create the same policies (applied on Ivan's Neon test branch), and generated apps start without migrations (the CLI does not copy prisma/migrations).
decisions.decision: prisma/rls/identity.sql (User, Organization, Membership, OrganizationSettings, AuditEvent) and one file per module with tenant tables, written from the policies a migrated database actually has (same names and predicates, readable SQL; CrmActivity's ::uuid variant normalized to the ::text form used by every other table). Each file is idempotent (ENABLE, FORCE, DROP POLICY IF EXISTS, CREATE POLICY) so it can run on top of the existing migrations. scripts/rls-sql.mjs orders files identity first, then manifest module order; db-init.mjs and the CC-016 harness both apply that text. db:init: with no migrations, migrate dev --name init, then migrate dev --create-only --name rls filled with the SQL and applied; with migrations, migrate deploy then prisma db execute of the same SQL. Existing migrations are not rewritten. tests/rlsFiles.test.ts requires every model with a required organizationId (plus User and Organization) to be forced exactly once, in its owner's file.

decisions.title: CC-024: module boundaries computed from the ownership resolver
decisions.context: CC-MOD-001/002 need each import's owner. Ownership is already computed by scripts/ownership.mjs (CC-019); the template lint found cross-module imports: billing settings rendering portal's billing template, projects/social importing portal's upload widget, base tests importing several modules, base settings reading module data.
decisions.decision: The plugin imports ownerOf from scripts/ownership.mjs through the Node subpath import #scripts/* (package.json imports) and reads hipster.modules.json from the lint cwd; with no manifest (factory root) the rule does nothing. Every static, re-export and dynamic import (type-only included) of an internal file is checked; same-owner and base targets pass, ambiguous owners are left to CC-MOD-003, lib/modules/registry.ts is the only base file allowed to import modules. Findings were fixed, not excepted: billing gets its own subscription fetcher/DTO/select and a billing:read permission (granted to OWNER, ADMIN, BILLING, the roles that held portal:billing); the upload widget moves to features/uploads (owned by uploads, a declared dependency of projects, social and portal); tests/domain-workflows.test.ts splits into per-module test folders. validation.yaml CC-MOD-001..003 lose status: planned.

decisions.title: CC-025: env declared per owner with defineEnv, checked against the manifest
decisions.context: CC-025 replaces ad-hoc process.env reads. Add-ons must keep working in demo mode when their keys are unset (Settings > Integrations shows MISSING SECRET), base had no place in the manifest for its variables, and lib/env/*.ts is TypeScript + server-only while repo checks are Node scripts.
decisions.decision: lib/env/base.ts exports defineEnv(owner, shape) with required()/optional() helpers (blank counts as unset, values trimmed). Each owner object validates lazily: read() throws once naming the owner and every missing variable, configured() and value(name) never throw, so demo mode stays. The manifest base gains env (schema change, Architecture.md 5.1); validateManifest rejects an env name declared twice and public scope without NEXT_PUBLIC_. scripts/env-example.mjs renders .env.example from the manifest (base, then modules in order). scripts/check-env.mjs runs under tsx --conditions=react-server, imports each lib/env/<owner>.ts and compares names and required with the manifest, checks .env.example freshness and fails on process.env outside lib/env/** and *.config.*; it is pnpm check:env in validate and CI. NODE_ENV goes through lib/env/mode.ts (not server-only, Next inlines it) so client and vendored components need no process.env. Test and child-process env go through baseEnv.value and childEnv. prisma seed runs with --conditions=react-server. lib/integrations/status.ts (base) still lists add-on variable names via hasValues until CC-026 moves integration status into the modules.

decisions.title: CC-026: compose script, per-owner seeds, Upstash ratelimit with database fallback
decisions.context: Add-ons must compose alone with base before the CLI exists. Composing showed one blocker: prisma/seed.ts (base) seeded every module. ratelimit existed only as an empty module; AI generation was limited by a database count under an advisory lock. Settings > Integrations listed every provider from base.
decisions.decision: scripts/compose.mjs performs the file steps of the CLI pipeline (copy tracked files, drop files owned by unselected modules, strip // @module lines, rewrite registry and manifest, regenerate .env.example); scripts/check-compose.mjs composes base + each add-on and base alone and runs prisma generate, tsc and eslint there (pnpm check:compose, own CI job, ~5 min). Seeds move to prisma/seeds/<owner>.ts exporting seed(context); prisma/seed.ts loads whichever exist in dependency order inside one transaction (call sequence verified identical; the seed audit event now lists the owners actually seeded). ratelimit owns lib/integrations/upstash/** with enforceRateLimit (sliding window, throws RateLimitedError code RATE_LIMITED); the AI workflow uses it before the transaction when UPSTASH_* is set and keeps the database count as the fallback otherwise (its error now also carries code RATE_LIMITED; the route maps the code to 429). ModuleDefinition.integration {name, purpose, env} replaces the base provider list. Presets must be closed under dependsOn (validateManifest); social preset gains uploads (dependency since CC-024).

decisions.title: CC-027: projects is the golden slice; ActionResult contract lands in projects first
decisions.context: AUTH.md §5.3/§8 require actions to return ActionResult and cross-tenant ids to yield NOT_FOUND. projects actions threw, versioned updates reported CONFLICT even for ids outside the organization, and the workspace workflow threw on a missing project.
decisions.decision: types/actionTypes.ts defines ActionResult/ActionErrorCode; lib/utils/actionResult.ts maps errors by their `code` (ZodError -> VALIDATION with fieldErrors, unknown -> INTERNAL with a generic message, redirect/notFound rethrown). Base errors carry codes (UNAUTHENTICATED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, VALIDATION). projects actions: requireIdentity -> withTenantTransaction -> assertPermission -> schema.parse -> write -> invalidatePaths -> ActionResult. A versioned update matching no row counts the row in the org: CONFLICT if present, NOT_FOUND otherwise (staleOrMissing). Fetchers/workflows return null and features call notFound(). Each projects file opens with a one-line `Why:` comment; Architecture.md Appendix A lists the slice, generated by template/scripts/slice-files.mjs. Other modules keep throwing until a follow-up migrates them; AUTH.md requireTenant/permission-string naming stays deferred to #234.

decisions.title: CC-028: hipster-stack package, global link via pnpm add --global link:<abs path>
decisions.context: tech-requirements.md said cli:link runs `pnpm link --global` in packages/cli. pnpm 12 has no `link --global`; a relative `link:` in `pnpm add --global` resolves against pnpm's global dir, not the cwd.
decisions.decision: packages/cli is the workspace package `hipster-stack` (private, bin hipster-stack -> dist/cli.mjs, built by tsdown; dependencies stay external because the global link points at packages/cli and resolves its own node_modules). Root `cli:link` = `pnpm cli:build && node scripts/cli-link.mjs`, which runs `pnpm add --global link:<absolute packages/cli>`; it needs pnpm's global bin dir on PATH (`pnpm setup` once). Template resolution: HIPSTER_TEMPLATE, else <repo>/template found by walking up to packages/; the directory must hold hipster.modules.json; --help prints the resolved template. Subcommands register in src/commands/index.ts from CC-029. Root CI builds and runs the bundle.

decisions.title: CC-029: CLI composes through the template's own scripts; template-pinned tests stay in the template
decisions.context: The template already owns the manifest schema, ownership rules, compose file steps and .env.example renderer (CC-018..CC-026). A generated blank app failed its own pnpm test because several template tests pin the full module set (grants, dashboard, sidebar, ownership snapshot, RLS model count).
decisions.decision: packages/cli/src/compose/composeApp.ts loads template/scripts/{compose,modules-schema}.mjs and the template's Prettier from the resolved template (needs the template's install), then: closure (now detects cycles) -> compose() with exclude [prisma/migrations/, tests/template/] -> prune package.json deps only removed modules declare + rename -> optional brand color -> hipster.json -> Prettier on written files. new.ts adds prompts/flags (--preset, --modules, --all, --color, --name, --yes, --no-install, --no-git), prisma validate with the template's Prisma (cwd outside the app), pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile, git init. Brand: --primary = chosen hex as HSL triplet, --primary-foreground = whichever palette source contrasts more (warn under 4.5:1), --signal follows --primary only if that token exists (globals.css has none today). Without --color the template's reviewed tokens stay and hipster.json color is null (the documented #2f7a8d default measures 4.35:1 on the template foreground). Template tests that pin the full module set move to template/tests/template/; the generic invariants stay and their sanity thresholds became > 0.

decisions.title: CC-030: generated-app governance from static assets, doctrine pre-filled, drift-checked
decisions.context: Generated apps need the factory's governance shape (router, docs, contracts, execution state) without the factory's content. The template's own .claude/ is stale Maximal Template history that still points at .agents/.
decisions.decision: packages/cli/assets/app-governance holds 13 files with {{appName}}, {{createdAt}}, {{modules}}, {{modulesList}}, {{templateCommit}}, {{color}}, {{colorYaml}} placeholders; `new` renders them (unknown placeholder = error), refuses to overwrite, and formats them with the template's Prettier; `add` will never write them. Architecture.md §2-4 and AUTH.md §1-11 are copied from the factory doctrine with factory paths removed; app sections are TODO prompts for /idea. A root test fails if any CC-* id in template/eslint is missing from the asset Architecture.md. The CLI no longer copies the template's .claude/. Assets are in root .prettierignore because placeholders are not valid YAML until rendered.

decisions.title: CC-031: post-compose setup and opt-in provisioning in packages/cli/src/setup
decisions.context: `new` must commit the scaffold and optionally create the GitHub repo, Neon project and Vercel project, each skippable and idempotent, with no network use unless asked. Neon's API-created roles do not guarantee NOBYPASSRLS, and the CLI ships no database driver.
decisions.decision: packages/cli/src/setup holds exec (one injectable runner; Windows args quoted for the cmd shim), postCompose (prisma validate, pnpm install, git init, `chore: scaffold from hipster-stack`; a failed commit warns), provision (github, neon, vercel steps: check CLI + login, check before create, a failing step does not stop the next) and database. `neonctl projects create --role owner`; app_user is created in SQL as the owner with LOGIN NOBYPASSRLS, table rights and default privileges for tables db:init creates later (an existing app_user with BYPASSRLS is refused); SQL runs with the template's `pg`, like the template Prettier (DEC-044). .env.local gets DATABASE_URL (app_user, pooled) and DIRECT_DATABASE_URL (owner, direct), the template's key names. Vercel env vars go to production and preview as sensitive, value on stdin, --force. `new <dir with hipster.json> --provision` provisions only, so guidance can say re-run. Without --provision no gh/neonctl/vercel command runs; pnpm install is the only network use and --no-install removes it.

decisions.title: CC-032: slice scaffolder renders projects-derived templates and merges into existing module files
decisions.context: `slice` must generate a full vertical slice that passes every CC rule without edits, both as a new module and inside an existing one, without overwriting anything.
decisions.decision: packages/cli/src/slice: fields.ts (DSL: string, text, int, decimal, boolean, datetime, enum(a|b), ref(Model) with `<rel>Id` names, optional `?`; enum values become UPPER_SNAKE), tokens.ts (per-type Prisma/Zod/DTO/form fragments; render() throws on unknown tokens), merge.ts (TS-AST merge using the app's typescript: named imports join or add import lines, bodies are appended, name clashes refuse), prismaSchema.ts, sliceApp.ts (planSlice computes every write and throws on any conflict before writing). Templates: packages/cli/templates/slice/*.tpl with {{token}}, excluded from Prettier. New module: lib/modules/<m>.module.ts, a manifest entry (kind domain, owns app/(tenant)/<route>/**, dependsOn = owners of ref targets) and a regenerated registry. Existing module: nav link + resource are added to its definition. Back-relations go on Organization and ref targets tagged `// @module <m>`; RLS appends to prisma/rls/<m>.sql. Refs are tenant-checked in the action (tenant model by id + organizationId, User via membership). After writing: prisma format + generate, prettier --write, eslint --fix. The CLI entry prints `hipster-stack: <message>` and exits 1 (HIPSTER_DEBUG=1 shows the stack).

decisions.title: CC-033: `add` carries the difference between two template compositions into the app
decisions.context: `add` must bring a module (and its dependsOn) into an app that may have changed since `new`, including slice modules and slice back-relations in base schema files, and must refuse instead of overwriting the app's changes.
decisions.decision: planAdd composes the current template twice into a temp dir (the app's installed template modules, and those plus the requested closure) with the same exclusions as `new`, and applies only what differs: files new in the second composition are created (a file already at that path is a conflict unless identical); schema files regain their `// @module <added>` lines, each inserted after its preceding non-blank template line inside the same model block (app lines stay; a missing block is a conflict); any other changed file is replaced only if the app still has the first composition's content. Registry, hipster.modules.json (template modules in template order, then the app's own modules) and .env.example are rebuilt; package.json gains the added modules' `packages` at the template's versions; hipster.json lists the template modules. All conflicts are listed and nothing is written. Then template prisma format + validate, pnpm install (unless --no-install) and prisma generate. A template commit different from hipster.json's is a warning, not a refusal.

decisions.title: CC-034: doctor is read-only and reads env presence only
decisions.context: doctor must report env, database, migrations, RLS, lint and ownership readiness with fix hints, on apps that may hold real credentials in .env.local.
decisions.decision: packages/cli/src/doctor/checks.ts runs six checks and returns pass/warn/fail/skip rows with a hint; the command prints a plain table and exits 1 on any fail. Env: required names from the app manifest (base + modules) against the shell, .env.local and .env (Next.js precedence); values are only tested for presence and never printed; missing ones warn by name. Database: DIRECT_DATABASE_URL, else DATABASE_URL, through the template's `pg` (as provisioning, DEC-046) with a 10s connect timeout; unreachable skips the dependent checks. Migrations: prisma/migrations dirs vs finished rows in _prisma_migrations. RLS: relrowsecurity and relforcerowsecurity on every model with a required organizationId plus User and Organization (the template's rlsFiles test rule). Lint and ownership run the app's own scripts; --no-tools skips them; not installed warns. doctor writes nothing.

decisions.title: CC-035: preset matrix in ci.yml, gated by a changes job; `compose` command for CI
decisions.context: Every preset and --all must compose, install, lint, typecheck and build, on PRs touching template/ or packages/cli/ and on main. Architecture §6 lists `compose` as the non-interactive CI command.
decisions.decision:
`hipster-stack compose --preset|--modules|--all [--color] [--name]` runs composeApp + prisma validate with no prompts, install or git (fromFlags shared with `new`). ci.yml gets job `changes` (git diff against the PR base; always true on push) and job `presets`, an 11-way fail-fast:false matrix (blank, nine presets, all) that composes into template/.sandbox/

(turbopack needs the app inside template/), installs with --no-frozen-lockfile (pruned package.json), then lint, typecheck and build with placeholder env values. ci.yml itself also triggers the matrix. pnpm store cached by setup-node on both lockfiles. The older `compose` job (each add-on alone, template script) stays.

decisions.title: CC-035: fix the undeclared admin and portal dependencies the preset matrix found
decisions.context: The presets matrix failed typecheck for admin (counts rows in eight domain modules; writes BillingSubscription) and portal (reads Invoice) because neither declares those modules. check:compose only composed add-ons alone.
decisions.decision: ModuleDefinition gains `records` ({label, model}); each domain module lists its countable table and admin's record summary counts whatever the registry holds (as nav/dashboard do, DEC-036). The provider-state reconcile moves from admin to billing (schemas/billingSchemas.ts, lib/actions/billingActions.ts reconcileBillingProviderState, lib/db/transactions/billing-reconcile-provider-state.tx.ts, select/DTO/types in billing files) under a new billing:manage permission (OWNER/ADMIN). portal declares dependsOn invoicing; the portal preset becomes [portal, invoicing, uploads, billing] (Architecture.md §5, application.yaml). Admin preset stays [admin]. Accepted by the owner on 2026-10-24 (decision card option "Modules report their own counts").

decisions.title: CC-036: plugin skeleton, local marketplace and generated doctrine reference
decisions.context: CC-036 asks for references/doctrine.md 'generated from validation.yaml', but the classifier lives in Architecture.md §3.3 (intent, highest authority), not in the contract.
decisions.decision: plugin/loaded-vibes/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (loaded-vibes 0.1.0, MIT like the repo) and root .claude-plugin/marketplace.json (marketplace codependent-coding, source ./plugin/loaded-vibes). scripts/plugin-doctrine.mjs (`pnpm plugin:doctrine`, `--check`) renders the classifier from Architecture.md §3.3 and the CC rule table from validation.yaml, Prettier-formatted; tests/plugin/plugin.test.ts fails when the file is stale or misses a rule. No skills/agents/hooks yet (CC-037..CC-041). No plugin icon: the validator's ICON_MISSING warning only matters for directory submission.

decisions.title: CC-037: /idea skill and the governance check
decisions.context: The skill must write docs and compile YAML in a generated app, prove the YAML is valid and ask at most ~12 questions. Generated apps have no yaml package, and the plugin cannot install dependencies.
decisions.decision: plugin/loaded-vibes/skills/idea/SKILL.md runs a 12-question Mad-Libs grill (one proposal per question, skip -> PRD open questions), edits only the app-owned sections (PRD all; tech §4-5; Architecture §1, §6; AUTH §12; Design §1 paragraph) and the TODO keys of the three contracts, records DEC entries, and hands back ordered `hipster-stack slice` commands without running them. plugin/loaded-vibes/scripts/governance-check.mjs parses the contracts with the app's own Prettier (yaml parser) and fails on any TODO outside HTML comments; the skill calls it via ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}. skills/idea/example.md is the worked GreenRoute session.

decisions.title: CC-038: /plan skill and the app's issues:sync
decisions.context: Generated apps need the factory's issue format and a sync script, but scripts/github/sync-issues.mjs is factory-specific (CC- prefix, fixed milestones, labels.yml) and does not validate.
decisions.decision: template/scripts/sync-issues.mjs (base-owned, so every composed app ships it) with `pnpm issues:sync`: dry run validates every context/specs/issues file (name <PREFIX>-NNN-<slug>.md, required fields, enums, id = file name, Summary/Scope/Acceptance sections, unique ids, depends_on targets) and exits 1 on any problem; it stays offline without a GitHub remote. `--apply` upserts labels (frontmatter labels, else type/area/priority/size), creates frontmatter milestones and missing issues matched by '<ID> ·' title prefix, then rewrites Depends on with numbers (.github-map.json). The app issue README format gains milestone and labels, matching the factory frontmatter. plugin skills/plan/SKILL.md decomposes the PRD into slice, rule, module, deploy and goal-test issues, runs the dry run, updates handoff, and only offers --apply (it writes to GitHub).

decisions.title: CC-039: /slice and /classify skills, classify measured by plugin evals
decisions.context: 'Classify answers 10 sample prompts correctly' needs a repeatable measure; 'slice yields lint-clean code with domain logic filled' needs a real run.
decisions.decision: skills/slice/SKILL.md: gather from the issue/PRD, `hipster-stack slice --dry-run` then for real, fill only rules (schemas refine, action-derived values, authz policies, permissions, workflows, transactions, fetcher order), a test per rule, then format/lint/typecheck/test(/test:rls). skills/classify/SKILL.md: answer path/layer/why/rules from references/doctrine.md only; slice naming wins in features/<d>/; DTO types live in types/<d>Types.ts. Ten classify cases in plugin/loaded-vibes/evals/classify-* with regex graders on the path line, run with `claude plugin eval` (first run 8/10 exposed the form-name and DTO-type ambiguity; the skill now states both; rerun 20/20). Skill examples use a different domain (shop) so evals do not leak answers.

decisions.title: CC-040: /check, /ship, /handoff skills and app-only plugin hooks
decisions.context: The plugin hooks must reuse the factory hooks yet stay silent outside generated apps; ship touches production; check and handoff need repeatable checks.
decisions.decision: hooks/hooks.json calls hooks/when-app.mjs <hook>, which exits 0 unless hipster.json is at CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and otherwise imports a byte-identical copy of the factory hook (a test keeps the copies equal; the marketplace installs only plugin/loaded-vibes, so the plugin cannot reach .claude/hooks at runtime). Helper scripts: lint-findings.mjs (groups ESLint JSON by [CC-*] prefix), ship-env.mjs (names from .env.example, values from .env.local on stdin to `vercel env add --environment production --sensitive --force --yes`, *_TEST* names stay local, dry run by default), smoke.mjs (same two checks as tests/e2e/smoke.spec.ts), execution-check.mjs (schema, append-only DEC ids, issue ids have files, acceptance lines start with an evidence state). /ship deploys only after the owner says to ship in that conversation.

decisions.title: CC-041: read-only reviewer and verifier agents
decisions.context: Review and evidence checks must be independent of the session that did the work.
decisions.decision: agents/reviewer.md and agents/verifier.md have tools Read, Grep, Glob, Bash only (a test forbids Edit/Write) and say they change nothing. The reviewer maps each AUTH.md §11 item to a CC ID (CC-WRITE-003, CC-SEC-001..006, CC-TX-002, CC-CLIENT-001), runs lint-findings.mjs first, and reports '[severity] CC-ID file:line what. Fix: ...' plus a verdict. The verifier reruns every EXECUTED claim for the scoped issues exactly as written, compares exit codes and counts, and reports CONFIRMED / CONTRADICTED / UNVERIFIABLE / MISSING (required profile checks with no claim); it never runs deploys, GitHub writes or production database commands. Measured with headless runs on planted violations rather than plugin evals: the cases need an installed app as fixture.

decisions.title: CC-042: dogfood run headless, owner answers up front, friction as GitHub issues
decisions.context: The dogfood run must exercise the skills as shipped, but the owner is not in the loop for each grill question, and the deploy needs his go-ahead.
decisions.decision: Each phase ran as a headless `claude -p` with --plugin-dir and explicit Edit/Write(.claude/**) allow rules; the /idea answers were written up front and I played the owner for DEC-004 (vendor userId link) only. Friction points went to GitHub as issues #255-#261 with the `dogfood` label in milestone M6, without spec files: they are follow-ups for the owner to schedule, not v1 scope. The deploy waits on the owner's decision card; CC-042 stays in-progress until a URL exists or he picks the gap-analysis option.

decisions.title: Fix dogfood bug #255 before CC-043
decisions.context: The CC-042 dogfood run found that test:rls fails in every generated app without the crm module: the negative check looked up CrmContact by name. PRD §8 needs RLS evidence for generated apps, so v1 cannot ship with it.
decisions.decision: The negative check now disables RLS on catalog.tenantTables[0] (every app has one; the harness seeds every tenant table) instead of a named crm table. The other dogfood issues (#256-#261) stay for the owner to schedule.

decisions.title: No app deploys in v1; the job is the template
decisions.context: CC-040 and CC-042 asked for a deployed URL from a generated app, which needed new cloud resources. Owner (2026-10-25): "Our job here is to make the template, not to deploy apps."
decisions.decision: PRD G2 and §8.4 now measure a validated app running locally. /ship stays in the plugin for the owner to use per app; no thread deploys apps or asks for Clerk/Neon/Vercel resources. CC-042 closed on local evidence. Owner also removed GitHub Actions (2026-10-25); merges rely on local checks.

decisions.title: Release v1.0.0 on local checks; dogfood follow-ups leave M6
decisions.context: CC-044 closes M0-M6 and tags v1.0.0. The owner removed GitHub Actions and asked for the dogfood issues #256-#261 to stay open unless they block v1; none does.
decisions.decision: The release profile runs locally on a fresh clone of main. #256-#261 have no milestone now (still open). Tag v1.0.0 on the CC-044 merge commit with notes from progress.json.

decisions.title: Remove GitHub Actions CI
decisions.context: The owner called the GitHub Actions runs excessive and wasteful and asked for all of them to be removed. PR #265 wrote this as a second DEC-060 inside the existing entry, which broke the file; restored as its own entry on 2026-10-26.
decisions.decision: Delete .github/workflows/ci.yml (the only workflow file) and disable the leftover registered workflows. PRs merge when the local checks pass: root `pnpm validate` and `pnpm --dir template validate` (plus `pnpm --dir template test:rls` when RLS code changes). Dependabot config is untouched.

decisions.title: One progress record format for every skill; generated apps allow .claude writes
decisions.context: Dogfood issues #256 and #259: skills wrote progress.json in different shapes, and headless runs could not write .claude/ at all. Owner (2026-10-26): the three JSON files are decisions, progress (the per-turn changelog) and handoff (persists across sessions), and skills must be able to write them.
decisions.decision: The app-governance progress.json `format` field is now an object with the statuses, issue entry, evidence entry and evidence states. /idea, /plan, /slice, /check and /ship point at it and end by running execution-check.mjs, which now also rejects unknown top-level keys in progress.json. Generated apps ship .claude/settings.json allowing Edit/Write(.claude/**) plus the read-only commands the skills run (not `issues:sync --apply`). Also repaired this repo's three execution files, which #265 and #267 left as invalid JSON; the CI-removal decision is now DEC-062.

decisions.title: `new` asks for the Neon connection string and builds the database
decisions.context: Dogfood issues #257 (test:rls fails until db:init has made migrations) and #258 (build needs DATABASE_URL). Owner (2026-10-26): have the CLI require the Neon connection string, wire it up, and use the non-pooler URL as Prisma's direct URL.
decisions.decision: Interactive `new` without --provision asks for the connection string (required at the prompt; `--database-url` for scripts; `--yes` alone skips). The CLI derives pooled/direct by adding/removing `-pooler` on a neon.tech host (other hosts are used as is), creates app_user as the string's owner role, writes DATABASE_URL (app_user, pooled) and DIRECT_DATABASE_URL (owner, direct), and runs `pnpm db:init` before the initial commit so prisma/migrations is committed. The RLS harness now fails with 'run pnpm db:init once and commit prisma/migrations' when there are none, and prisma.config treats a blank DIRECT_DATABASE_URL as unset. Build-time-optional DATABASE_URL was not done: the prompt fills .env.local instead.

decisions.title: Four roles and <module>.<resource>:<action> permissions (#234)
decisions.context: AUTH.md §5.2 and application.yaml define owner > admin > member > viewer and `<module>.<resource>:<action>`; the code had 8 roles and `<module>:<action>` (DEC-036 deferred it). Owner (2026-10-26): authorization lives in lib/authz with roles, permissions, an RBAC part and an ABAC part, used by every fetcher and action; lib/db holds selects/, transactions/, dto/, the one Prisma client file, an auth wrapper and an RLS wrapper. Owner chose "Viewer means outside client" on the decision card (2026-10-26).
decisions.decision: Prisma enum MembershipRole is OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER, VIEWER (uppercase kept); migration 20261026000000_four_membership_roles maps MANAGER/BILLING/SUPPORT to MEMBER and CLIENT to VIEWER. MEMBER is staff with the union of the old staff grants (read/create/update per module, delete in crm, billing read); VIEWER is an outside person (client) with the old CLIENT grants, and policies limit viewers to shared or own records. Module definitions list `<module>.<resource>` resources and per-role grants as actions or single permissions; the catalog is resources x actions. Base resources use the `base.` prefix. Old MANAGER loses manage-any-record (members manage own or assigned). lib/authz: roles.ts adds the hierarchy and isOutsideRole; policies.ts is the ABAC layer (limitedToOwnRecords replaces role === CLIENT). lib/db/provider.ts is now lib/db/rls.ts with setRlsContext, which tenant.ts (the auth wrapper) also uses. Slice templates generate `<module>.<entity>` resources with MEMBER read/create/update.

decisions.title: One targeted CI workflow plus a Conventional PR-title check (replaces DEC-062's no-CI rule)
decisions.context: Owner (2026-10-26, note on #261): bring CI back, industry standard but lightweight and targeted: lint, format, typegen/typecheck, and only the Vitest/Playwright tests an edit needs; no per-module fan-out; proper GitHub workflow with Conventional titles, labels, milestones, issues traced to docs, PRs that auto-close issues and clean up branches. The old ci.yml ran root, template, compose, Neon RLS and an 11-preset build matrix on every PR.
decisions.decision: .github/workflows/ci.yml: job `changes` diffs the PR base (or previous main) and gates `root`, `template` and `template-db`. Docs-only edits run only root format:check. Root tests are chosen by area (tests/cli, tests/plugin, tests/doctrine). Template runs its ~3 s unit suite whole; Playwright smoke only when app code changes; `build` only when build config or deps change; RLS runs against a Postgres 16 service container (no Neon branch, no secrets). The preset matrix and check:compose job are dropped. .github/workflows/pr-title.yml enforces Conventional PR titles. Squash-only with the PR title as the commit title is a repo setting the owner applies (the cloud proxy blocks settings writes). Issue forms carry Conventional titles, a required Docs / spec field and auto-add to Project #19; labels gained type:perf/build/revert and dependencies; Dependabot uses chore(deps)/ci(deps). Milestones M0-M6 closed; open follow-ups moved to v1.1.0.

decisions.title: Repo hygiene: kebab-case asset names, standard community file names
decisions.context: Owner asked to clean up the repo and organize it to industry conventions. Asset file names had spaces, mixed case and misspellings (BusinnesLogic, seperator); community files were CODE_Of_CONDUCT.md and SUPPORT.MD; .gitignore had a typo (.evn.local) and entries for removed tooling.
decisions.decision: Rename public/ and template/public/ assets to kebab-case (business-logic-logo.jpg, separator.png, logo-cloud.png) and update every reference; rename to CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and SUPPORT.md; tidy .gitignore; drop the stale .agents exclude from tsconfig.build.json; drop the retired Anthimeria term from package.json. No files deleted: the unused brand logos stay in public/ for the owner to decide.

decisions.title: Invitations and single or multi tenancy (#260)
decisions.context: Owner (2026-10-26, #260): onboarding and invitations wired when appropriate, custom orgs in Prisma, RLS on sensitive tables, idempotent transactions. The template had an INVITED membership status but no way to invite anyone.
decisions.decision: New Invitation model (email, role, status PENDING/ACCEPTED/REVOKED, sha256 tokenHash, expiresAt) with RLS: org rows plus read-only rows sent to the signed-in user's email; writes stay in the org. Owners/admins invite (base.membership:create) and get a one-time /invite/<token> link; revoke needs base.membership:delete. invitation.tx.ts accepts idempotently (sets the org RLS context, PENDING to ACCEPTED, create or reactivate membership, active membership keeps its role, audit event). The Clerk user.created webhook accepts a pending invitation by email first. lib/constants/tenancy.ts: tenancy multi (new user gets own org) or single (first user claims slug main via INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, others join by invite). The CLI choice that sets tenancy and RBAC/ABAC comes in the next PR.
